UNDERTAKING TO RECEIVE PAYMENTS IN ZAMEEN MEDALLION (PRIVATE) LIMITED 'S BANK ACCOUNT TILL THE OPENING OF THE ESCROW ACCOUNT 
 Dear Sir, 
 M/s Salman Developers (“ SD ”) through its duly authorised representative namely , Muhammad Numan son of Mian Muhammad Salman , the undersigned , entered into IT Services Agreement dated ___ April 202 5 with Zameen Media (Private) Limited (“ Zameen Media ”) for the provision of IT and IT - enabled services (“ IT Services Agreement ”) and the Project Sales Agreement dated ___ April 202 5 with Zameen Core (SMC-Private) Limited (“ Zameen Sales ”) for the provision of sales and marketing services (“ Project Sales Agreement ”) related to the real estate project named and styled as ‘ Grand Square Mall ’ ( Zameen Media and Zameen Sales shall hereinafter be collectively referred as “ Zameen ”). 
 
 The undersigned understands that clause 9 of both the IT Services Agreement and the Project Sales Agreement mandates the establishment of an escrow account. At present, the process of setting up this escrow account is underway. In the meantime, as the undersigned is obligated to make payments for the services rendered by Zameen under the aforementioned agreements; hence, the undersigned hereby authori s e s Zameen Medallion (Private) Limited (“ Zameen Medallion ”) to receive payments under the aforementioned agreements until a separate escrow account is established for this purpose , in Zameen Medallion’s following account number :

 This undertaking will be in force until the establishment and operation of the separate escrow account as stipulated in the IT Services Agreement and the Project Sales Agreement. This arrangement is temporary and solely for facilitating payments for services rendered by Zameen under the agreements mentioned above . Furthermore, b y authorising payments to Zameen Medallion's bank account, the undersigned waives any claims or liabilities of Zameen related to the handling of these funds. 
 
 Additionally, the undersigned undertakes to cooperate with Zameen in promptly establishing the separate escrow account as soon as possible. The undersigned understand s that the importance of securing payments in a dedicated account for the protection of both parties involved is necessary for the smooth operations of the business arrangement . 
 
 Please find attached any necessary documentation or forms required to facilitate this arrangement. If you require any further information or clarification, please do not hesitate to contact me at the provided contact details.
